answers.text: "day_vol 1.26 is under the R4 1.40 bar": a volume bar is O'Neil's test, not mine. Mine is trend plus new high (C5): W HH/HL, 9>21, D above EMA9, 2.87% under the 20-day high. His H1 21.9% close I already read as a reaction running, so I wait for the new high; the claim stands.

"rs_rank_pct 69.65 fails criterion 8": the Template is not my test. He grants D dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.24 and HH/HL; W above EMA9, 9>21; H1 91.1% of range. That is an Upward Trend at its high (C5), and ROKU is the second group name (C14).

"day_vol 1.39 is under the R4 1.40 bar": I hold no volume bar; day_vol is only a proxy to me (R5). He grants D HH/HL, W 1.22% under the 20-wk high, H1 above EMA9. A base count is not my entry; the new closing high is (C5, C16).

"Heavy volume closing at the low is distribution": the weak close is evidence I use, and I read it as a reaction under way (D red, H1 LH/LL, 14.0% of range), not as an ended trend: W HH/HL, D 9>21 hold. I support only the new high after it (C5), so I wait; the trend claim stands.

"A new high only counts on breakout volume": not in my book. He grants W and D HH/HL, 0.45% under the 20-wk high; flow is not on my menu. A brand-new high in an Upward Trend is the C16 buy; the price is the signal (C2).

"no buy point without breakout volume (day_vol 0.24": a quiet reaction is exactly what C8 calls normal. W and D HH/HL, 1.07% under the 20-day high; H1 below EMA9 at 39.1% says the new high is not in yet, which is my trigger, not a refutation.

"a quiet reaction is not a position entry": agreed, and I never buy the reaction (C5). My claim was trend plus a normal reaction: he grants W HH/HL, 9>21; D 2.5% under the 20-day high. My entry is the close above pivot_high, the same break he wants. Claim stands.

"about 72% above the 200-day, a C24 climax": distance from an average is not my danger signal. Mine is a one-day reaction of 1x atr_14d from the day's high (C7, my translation), not printed: W HH/HL, D above EMA9 1.71% under the high. I do not sell a trend on extension alone (C15).

"a strong close inside RANGE... is not a break": agreed it is not my entry either. He grants W/D HH/HL and H1 100% of the day's range: trend intact, strongest close, as claimed. I buy the close above pivot_high (C5), not this bar.
